ns2:section.sectionText: DESIGN LIKE A PHYSICIST Becoming the fearless toolsmith: you will address a real-world problem with your physicist’s insight and the tools of electrical and mechanical engineers. There will be IDEs and PCBs and 3-D printers, and a treat bag at the end of the course. STUDENTS UNABLE TO RETURN TO CAMPUS Students who are unable to return to Campus and are in need of remote instruction should contact the Department of Physics using the following Queue: https://queue.illinois.edu/q/queue/760 for assistance.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Engineering Physics or Physics or Teaching of Physics major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
